proposal_id.producer_rule: caller_supplied_only; no text inference, random generation, or producer synthesis
proposal_id.collision_rule: detect duplicate proposal_id within identical agent_id/session_id scope

declared_targets.validation: strict; reject partial, malformed, duplicate, or unsupported records

structural_evidence_mapping.proposal_id: EVENT entity representing a declared proposal event
structural_evidence_mapping.target: entity in inherited proposal scope using declared target_type

alternatives.B_separate_envelope: rejected; deterministic binding requires extra registry or wrapper
alternatives.C_arguments_or_text_convention: rejected; cannot supply a strict typed contract

implementation_guards: preserve legacy to_dict output when optional fields are absent
do not alter gate, controller, adapters, regulators, or structural evidence without separate authorization
require frozen Structural Evidence hashes to remain unchanged
